name: ff14-gear-sync-analysis
description: Item level sync calculator and gear optimizer for FFXIV (single-file HTML page)

scripts.lint:py: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check .
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run smoke
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run lint:py && npm run test:data
scripts.update-data: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/data/fetch.py && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/data/regen.py
